target.title: fix(feishu): cap sender-name and streaming token caches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two unbounded in-process caches in the Feishu plugin that grow monotonically on long-lived gateways:

1. **`senderNameCache`** (`bot-sender-name.ts`) — stores resolved bot display names keyed by `botToken`. Every distinct token occupies a permanent `Map` entry with no eviction path.
2. **`tokenCache`** (`streaming-card.ts`) — stores per-`{agentId, runId}` tenant access tokens for streaming card updates. Entries are never removed; on a multi-agent Feishu instance this Map grows with every agent run over the gateway's lifetime.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` after every cache-set call on both Maps:

| Cache | Cap | File |
|---|---|---|
| `senderNameCache` | 500 | `bot-sender-name.ts` |
| `tokenCache` | 256 | `streaming-card.ts` |

`bot-sender-name.ts` uses a named `cacheFeishuSenderName` helper to keep the three call sites consistent. `streaming-card.ts` applies the cap inline immediately after `tokenCache.set`. Both use LRU eviction (delete-then-reinsert pattern) so recently used entries survive. Test-reset exports are added to `beforeEach`/`afterEach` hooks for isolation.

**Diff:** 4 files, +81 / −2 lines

## User Impact

Operators running Feishu channels on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for both lookup caches. Behavior is unchanged for normal workloads.

## Evidence

**Two new regression tests, both passing on `fix/feishu-cap-sender-and-token-caches`:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts \
    extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.test.ts \
    extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.test.ts \
    --reporter=verbose

 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > rejects oversized streaming tenant-token JSON before buffering the full body  49ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > rejects oversized streaming card-create JSON before buffering the full body   30ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > flushes throttled pending text after the throttle window                       7ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > handles a rejected scheduled flush update                                      1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > pushes natural-boundary updates immediately inside the throttle window         1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > retries cumulative content after a failed streaming update                     2ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > retries cumulative content after a non-OK streaming update                     1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > replaces content when final text removes transient streamed status             1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > drops a surrogate pair whole when truncating the closeout summary              9ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > logs a final replacement failure when CardKit returns non-OK                   1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > reports no visible content when final close update fails                       1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > bounds streaming token cache lifetime when token expiry overflows              1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > bounds streaming token fallback lifetime when the process clock is invalid     1ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > treats an invalid process clock as a streaming token cache miss                0ms
 ✓ FeishuStreamingSession > evicts oldest streaming token cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap    30ms
 ✓ resolveFeishuSenderName > reuses a cached sender name within the TTL                                    0ms
 ✓ resolveFeishuSenderName > does not cache sender names when the expiry would exceed Date range           0ms
 ✓ resolveFeishuSenderName > evicts oldest sender name cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap        3ms

```
